components.label: Chasing Innings Dominance
components.description: Batting performance in 2nd innings run chasing appearances where a target was pursued regardless of final match outcome.
components.inclusionRules: Second innings chases with known target (excluding abandoned without play).
components.deliveryRules: All legal deliveries and no-balls faced by the batter while chasing.
components.numerator: Runs scored in 2nd innings run chases.
components.missingDataBehavior: Returns status: insufficient-sample with score: null.
components.normalizationMethod: Tanh bounded transformation vs baseline: 50 + 50 * tanh((splitAvg - baseAvg) / baseAvg).
components.interpretationLimitation: High score indicates chase elevation, but does not isolate death-over high RRR situations from comfortable chases.

components.label: High-Pressure Situations (RRR >= 8.0)
components.description: Batting performance during run chase deliveries where the required run rate is stiff, severe, or extreme (>= 8.0 rpo).
components.inclusionRules: Deliveries with finite requiredRunRate >= 8.0 and ballsRemaining > 0.
components.deliveryRules: Official batter balls faced (legal deliveries + no-balls, excluding wides).
components.denominator: Dismissals when RRR >= 8.0 (if dismissals > 0) and official balls faced for strike rate.
components.baseline: Format overall chase strike rate and career average.
components.missingDataBehavior: Returns status: insufficient-sample with score: null.
components.normalizationMethod: Composite metric combining scoring rate elevation and dismissal resistance.
components.interpretationLimitation: Deliveries are situational slices; small-sample cells within specific phases can skew rates.

components.label: Tournament Knockout Elevation
components.description: Batting performance in ICC and continental tournament knockout fixtures (quarter-finals, semi-finals, finals, Super 8/12 knockout deciders).
components.inclusionRules: Matches tagged with tournament stage knockout, semi-final, final, or quarter-final in stage overrides.
components.deliveryRules: All deliveries faced in knockout fixtures.
components.missingDataBehavior: Returns status: insufficient-sample with score: null.
components.normalizationMethod: Ratio vs baseline transformed via bounded sigmoid / tanh curve.
components.interpretationLimitation: Knockout matches occur infrequently; sample size in T20I (N=7) remains below minimum threshold.

components.label: Tournament Finals Impact
components.description: Batting performance strictly in tournament finals (ICC World Cup, Champions Trophy, T20 World Cup, Asia Cup finals).
components.inclusionRules: Matches tagged with stage final in verified match stage registry.
components.deliveryRules: All deliveries faced in tournament finals.
components.missingDataBehavior: Returns status: insufficient-sample with score: null.
components.normalizationMethod: Bounded deviation scoring vs format baseline.
components.interpretationLimitation: CRITICAL SAMPLE LIMITATION: Limited sample sizes in tournament finals (N=10 ODI, N=3 T20I; T20I knockouts N=7) fail the robust calibration thresholds.

leakageSafeguards.mitigation: Computed strictly at delivery start from targetAtStart, scoreBefore, and ballsRemaining.
Derived strictly from zero-indexed over boundaries (0–9, 10–39, 40–49 in ODI).
Tournament schedule structure is fixed before match commencement.
Strictly partitioned into Population B/descriptive metrics; never used as a pre-delivery pressure predictor.

calibrationGates.requirement: Tournament finals slice must contain at least 10 batted innings in each format to support reliable statistical inference.
calibrationGates.observed: ODI finals: 10 innings. T20I finals: 3 innings (FAIL: 3 < 10). T20I knockouts: 7 innings (FAIL: 7 < 10).
calibrationGates.finding: ODI finals: 10 innings. T20I finals: 3 innings (FAIL: 3 < 10). T20I knockouts: 7 innings (FAIL: 7 < 10).
calibrationGates.blockerReason: Insufficient sample size in T20I tournament finals (N=3) and knockouts (N=7)

calibrationGates.requirement: Production cross-player Clutch Index requires a normalized multi-player dataset for empirical percentile calibration.
calibrationGates.observed: Repository contains strictly Virat Kohli match records. Cross-player peer corpus is unavailable.
calibrationGates.finding: Repository contains strictly Virat Kohli match records. Cross-player peer corpus is unavailable.
calibrationGates.blockerReason: Cross-player peer distribution unavailable in single-player dataset scope

calibrationGates.requirement: Components must not exhibit circular scoring or unadjusted double-counting across overlapping sets.
calibrationGates.observed: Tournament finals are 100.0% contained in knockouts (10/10 ODI, 3/3 T20I: containment(final in knockout) = 100.0%). Knockouts intersect with chases in 10/18 (55.6%) ODI innings (containment(knockout in chase) = 55.6%) and 2/7 (28.6%) T20I innings (containment(knockout in chase) = 28.6%).
calibrationGates.finding: Tournament finals are 100.0% contained in knockouts (10/10 ODI, 3/3 T20I: containment(final in knockout) = 100.0%). Knockouts intersect with chases in 10/18 (55.6%) ODI innings (containment(knockout in chase) = 55.6%) and 2/7 (28.6%) T20I innings (containment(knockout in chase) = 28.6%).
calibrationGates.blockerReason: Strict containment (100.0% finals in knockouts) and high overlap create circular score inflation and multicollinearity

calibrationGates.requirement: 95% bootstrap confidence interval width for key component raw batting averages (unit: runs per dismissal) must not exceed 25.0 runs/dismissal, and valid replicate rate must be >= 0.95 across all components.
calibrationGates.observed: ODI Finals Raw CI width is 25.81 runs/dismissal (SE: ±6.53). T20I Finals Raw CI width is 83 runs/dismissal (SE: ±30.19, valid rate: 96.0%). T20I Knockouts Raw CI width is 251.5 runs/dismissal. Exceeds 25.0 runs/dismissal threshold.
calibrationGates.finding: ODI Finals Raw CI width is 25.81 runs/dismissal (SE: ±6.53). T20I Finals Raw CI width is 83 runs/dismissal (SE: ±30.19, valid rate: 96.0%). T20I Knockouts Raw CI width is 251.5 runs/dismissal. Exceeds 25.0 runs/dismissal threshold.
calibrationGates.blockerReason: Confidence interval widths exceed 25.0 runs/dismissal threshold due to small sample sizes in tournament finals and knockouts

blockerReason: Tournament finals sample sizes (N=10 ODI, N=3 T20I; T20I knockouts N=7) fall below the robust threshold, bootstrap uncertainty width exceeds 25.0 runs/dismissal, and cross-player peer corpus is unavailable in a single-player dataset. Public score must remain null.
